ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image is a green parallelogram/rhombus-shaped quadrilateral, with two diagonals drawn inside. There is a right-angle mark at the intersection of the two diagonals, indicating that they are perpendicular to each other. One diagonal from the lower left to the upper right is divided by the intersection into two segments, labeled in the image as 30 ft and 30 ft respectively; the other diagonal from the upper left to the lower right is divided by the intersection into two segments, labeled 20 ft and 20 ft respectively. Reasoning: The full length of the diagonal from the lower left to the upper right is 30 + 30 = 60 ft. The full length of the diagonal from the upper left to the lower right is 20 + 20 = 40 ft. For a rhombus/kite shape whose diagonals are perpendicular to each other, the area formula is A = (d1 × d2) / 2. Therefore the area is (60 × 40) / 2 = 2400 / 2 = 1200.

method.method_draft: Read the figure as a parallelogram/rhombus-like quadrilateral whose two diagonals are drawn and meet at a right angle. Use the perpendicular-diagonals area formula for a rhombus/风筝形: area = (d1 × d2) / 2 = (60 × 40) / 2 = 1200.
